A soft break is a line break unless `softBreak` is `space`, one space, or `br`, `
` and a line break (C2-H-203). The 0.1 values `Newline`, `Space` and `Break` are `newline`, `space` and `br`.
`--allow-loss` stays and sets `allowLosses`, which the render and the HTML importer read: an allowed code is left out of the record and never fails `strictLosses` (C2-H-204, C2-T-027).
`--max-render-losses` stays and sets `maxLosses`, default 100 as in 0.1: the record keeps the first losses and counts the others in `suppressedDiagnostics` (C2-H-205, C2-T-029).
The 0.1 wikilinks extension read `[[Page]]`; 0.2 adds no delimiter for an extension, and the wiki form is `:wiki[Page]` (C2-X-013, C2-X-057). Rewrite only where the 0.1 host registered wikilinks.
The display text after the first `|` stays the display text and the fallback (C2-X-057). Rewrite only where the 0.1 host registered wikilinks.

Sample output is a span with the key `samp`, which a registered semantic span extension writes as `<samp>`; the key is an ordinary attribute of the core (C2-X-066). Rewrite only where the 0.1 host registered the `samp` extension.
